criteria.text: DynamicAgent.hbs instructions localized to Russian language
criteria.description: Template instructions should be in Russian (operational guidelines, response format descriptions) consistent with buildSavedAgentBody and PAI's Russian-default policy. | Verify: Grep: search for English-only instruction phrases in template

criteria.text: DynamicAgent.hbs has mandatory startup voice notification section
criteria.description: buildSavedAgentBody has startup voice curl ("Агент X загружает контекст"), but DynamicAgent.hbs has none. Add startup section. | Verify: Grep: search for startup curl pattern in template

criteria.text: Voice messages explicitly require Russian language in template
criteria.description: buildSavedAgentBody says "ALWAYS in Russian". DynamicAgent.hbs has no language specification for voice messages. | Verify: Grep: search for "Russian" or "русск" in template

criteria.text: Line 11 references Ivan not generic "the user"
criteria.description: "the user's experience" on line 11 should be personalized or use principal name. Template should pass principal context. | Verify: Grep: no "the user" in template

DynamicAgent.hbs correctly passes voice_settings, but buildSavedAgentBody's curl only sends message, voice_id, title — missing voice_settings, voice_enabled, volume. This is a reverse bug. | Verify: Grep: voice_settings in buildSavedAgentBody curl

criteria.text: Handlebars template compiles without errors after all changes
criteria.description: After modifications, template must still compile. Run ComposeAgent.ts with test traits to verify. | Verify: CLI: bun ComposeAgent.ts --traits analytical

criteria.text: Default voice name is valid registry entry not placeholder
criteria.description: Line 123: default: "{PRINCIPAL.NAME}" is an unresolved placeholder. Should be a real voice name from the registry (e.g. "Daniel"). | Verify: Grep: no {PRINCIPAL in Traits.yaml

criteria.text: Voice IDs in mappings match voice_registry entries exactly
criteria.description: Cross-reference every voice_id in mappings/fallbacks against voice_registry. Any mismatch = agent gets wrong voice. | Verify: CLI: script to compare

criteria.text: All defined expertise traits have keywords for auto-inference
criteria.description: ComposeAgent.ts inferTraitsFromTask depends on keywords. Missing keywords = trait never auto-selected. | Verify: Read: check each expertise has keywords array

criteria.text: Fallback traits cover all defined personality and approach keys
criteria.description: Personality keys: skeptical, analytical, enthusiastic. Approach: thorough, rapid, systematic. Each should have fallback voice. | Verify: Grep: each key in fallbacks section

criteria.text: Traits.yaml parses without YAML errors after all changes
criteria.description: After fixes, YAML must still parse cleanly. | Verify: CLI: bun ComposeAgent.ts --list

criteria.text: No unresolved placeholder strings in AgentPersonalities.md file
criteria.description: Replace all {PRINCIPAL.NAME} with Ivan and {DAIDENTITY.NAME} with Navi. | Verify: Grep: no PRINCIPAL or DAIDENTITY in file

criteria.text: Available traits list matches actual Traits.yaml definitions
criteria.description: Lines 145-147 list traits that don't exist in Traits.yaml. Update to match actual. | Verify: Read: compare lists

criteria.text: Source of truth statement reflects current architecture accurately
